titleCard: Hook (0.0-3.0), type only on flat black: "Your Logitech mouse," / "without Logi Options+." (accent) / "Meet Upright." There is no separate lockup scene. The real AppIcon appears only on the end card.

scenes.caption: Your Logitech mouse, / without Logi Options+. / Meet Upright.
scenes.onScreen: Centered type on flat #000, no UI. L1 "Your Logitech mouse," in primary #F5F5F7, 104px/600. L2 "without Logi Options+." in accent #0A84FF. Sub "Meet Upright." at 40px dim #86868B, with "Upright" in primary bold. Logitech and Logi Options+ appear as plain nominative text only.
scenes.motion: L1 enters at 0.15, L2 at 0.90 (0.5s outQuint, 12px rise, blur 6 to 0). The full hook is legible by 1.4. Sub enters at 2.0. All three exit together 2.70-2.95 (0.25s inCubic, opacity to 0, 10px rise out). SFX: soft ticks at 0.15 and 0.90.
scenes.visuals: No real UI, no logos, no mice. Flat #000 background, theme dark. No strike-through or comparison treatment of Logi Options+, because the claims guardrail says no Options+ comparisons beyond the hook.

scenes.caption: Every button. / Any action. -- Mission Control · Spaces · Media · Open App · Open URL · Run Shortcut
scenes.onScreen: Left column (x=120..860). Lead "Every button." in primary and "Any action." in accent, 68px/600. Sub is a two-line row of six typographic tokens (no pill backgrounds, so they do not read as app UI): Mission Control · Spaces · Media · Open App · Open URL · Run Shortcut, 30px dim. The active token brightens to primary with a 2px accent underline. Right: the real Settings > Buttons window (dark) in a 960px-wide card.
scenes.motion: Card enters 3.0-3.6 (y +40 to 0, scale .97 to 1, opacity, outQuint, soft shadow). Lead at 3.2, tokens at 3.6 (0.04s stagger). Active token steps every 0.5s: Mission Control 3.6, Spaces 4.1, Media 4.6, Open App 5.1, Open URL 5.6, Run Shortcut 6.1. Slow camera push z 1.0 to ~1.3 over 3.4-6.4 (inOutCubic) onto the button list. The highlight ring (2px accent, r10, 12px glow) appears at row 1 at 3.6 and steps down the rows in sync with the tokens (0.2s tween). It fades out 6.6-6.85. Caption exit 6.70-6.95. SFX: tick at 3.2.
scenes.visuals: Asset buttons.global (dark), with row rects from manifest.json. Primary: single state, ring steps over the rows. Upgrade if demo mode exports label variants buttons.global.1-6 (Mission Control, Spaces, Media, Open App, Open URL, Run Shortcut): pin the ring on the Top Button row and swap its label in sync (0.12s crossfade plus 8px slide, changed region settles 1.015 to 1). Never animate a picker or menu that was not exported. Open NSMenu popups probably will not export. No fake UI.

scenes.caption: Switch apps. / Your buttons follow. -- Per-app profiles, applied automatically.
scenes.onScreen: Lead "Switch apps." in primary and "Your buttons follow." in accent. Sub "Per-app profiles, applied automatically." Real Settings > Buttons (dark) with an app profile selected: the "Edit mappings for" picker, the overridden rows, and the "In effect now: the X profile" line.
scenes.motion: 7.0: card content swaps to the profile state (0.12s crossfade plus settle). The camera glides from the list to the profile picker over 7.0-7.7 (inOutCubic). Lead 7.2, sub 7.6. Ring on the "Edit mappings for" picker 7.7-8.5. Pan down to the overridden rows (z ~1.3) 8.5-9.2 with an accent tint wash on those rows (0.35 to 0 over 0.5s). Ring on the "In effect now" line 9.3-10.2. Caption exit 10.30-10.55. Ring out by 10.45.
scenes.visuals: Asset buttons.profile (dark), picked from installed apps so the icons render. Optional, only if demo mode exports a second real profile state (buttons.profile.2): swap at 8.9 with the tint wash, and add a mono (SF Mono 22px, dim, 1px connector) annotation chip naming the frontmost app, matching the app actually selected in each PNG. Without a second real state, show no chip, because a chip would imply a switch the image does not show.

scenes.caption: Hold. Move. Done. -- Five actions on one button: click, plus hold and move in four directions.
scenes.onScreen: Lead "Hold. Move. " in primary and "Done." in accent. Sub is the full script line, wrapped to 3 lines. Right: the real gesture editor, the Click, Up, Down, Left, Right grid, in the light theme. Below the copy at left: an abstract vector mouse silhouette (rounded capsule, 3px stroke, flat fill, one accent button zone), about 260px tall. No product detail, no logo.
scenes.motion: Theme flip via a 0.4s feathered (~160px) wipe left to right, 10.5-10.9 (inOutCubic), covering bg, card PNG and text colors (render both themes, CSS mask). Accent becomes #0071E3. Card shows gesture-editor with the camera at z ~1.35 on the five-action grid. Lead 10.8, sub 11.2, silhouette enters 11.0 (scale .96 to 1). Ring plus silhouette action per row: Click 11.30 (ripple r8 to r44, 0.5s), Up 11.85, Down 12.40, Left 12.95, Right 13.50. For each directional action the silhouette's button zone fills accent for 0.1s, a dot travels 90px in that direction over 0.4s (inOutCubic, trail fades 0.3s), and the matching UI row gets a ring (in 0.18, hold ~0.3, out 0.25). The ring tweens between rows. Caption exit 13.90-14.15. SFX: gentle whoosh at 10.6, tick at 10.8.
scenes.visuals: Asset gesture.editor (light), a button with all five actions filled. Silhouette is a vector drawn by the video lane and appears only in this scene. It is never drawn into captured UI. If the manifest lacks the five row rects, use ring rects measured by eye from the PNG and mark them for the audit.

scenes.caption: Tune the feel. -- Pointer speed presets. Wheel scrolling, reversed and smoothed, independent of your trackpad.
scenes.onScreen: Lead "Tune the feel." Sub as scripted, wrapped to 3 lines. 14.2-16.1: real Settings > Device (light) with the pointer speed slider and presets. 16.1-18.0: real Settings > Scrolling (light) with the reverse, speed and smooth rows. The app's own Experimental label next to smooth scrolling must stay visible and must not be cropped out.
scenes.motion: 14.2: swap to the Device pane (0.12s crossfade plus settle). The camera glides to the pointer speed section (z ~1.3) over 14.2-14.9. Lead 14.4, sub 14.8. Ring on slider plus presets 14.9-15.95 (in 0.18, out 0.25). 16.1: swap to Scrolling (0.12s crossfade, 8px slide up), camera z ~1.2 on the option rows. Ring tweens: Reverse vertical scrolling 16.45-17.0, Speed 16.95-17.45, Smooth 17.4-17.85. Caption exit 17.70-17.95. SFX: tick at 14.4.
scenes.visuals: Assets device.pointer (light) and scrolling (light, with reverse and smooth toggled on). Do not synthesize slider motion. Only if demo mode exports real variants device.pointer.800/1600/3200 may the compositor step through them (0.08s crossfades, DPI number pop 1.06 to 1 over 0.18s, at 15.0, 15.35, 15.7). Otherwise hold one static state. Scrolling is off by default and smooth is experimental, so it is not headlined.

scenes.caption: Three mice. / One menu bar. -- Battery at a glance, with low-battery alerts. Back the moment they wake.
scenes.onScreen: Lead "Three mice." in primary and "One menu bar." in accent. Sub "Battery at a glance, with low-battery alerts. Back the moment they wake." Right: the real menu-bar panel (light) listing the simulated MX Vertical, MX Master 3S and Lift. The mouse names appear only as the app's own UI text. Optional status-item crop (mouse icon plus battery %) from 20.2.
scenes.motion: 18.0: the window card fades out (0.3s, scale .98) while the portrait panel enters (y +30 to 0, opacity, outQuint, fit height <=820, center x=1360). Lead 18.2, sub 18.6. Rings on the battery rows: MX Vertical 18.9, MX Master 3S 19.35, Lift 19.8 (0.45s each, tweened). If a low-battery state exists, two accent pulses on that row (period 0.5s) at 20.0-20.5. 20.2-22.0: cross-move to a crop of the status-item battery % (0.7s inOutCubic), ring pulse at 20.8, hold. Caption exit 21.70-21.95. SFX: tick at 18.2.
scenes.visuals: Asset menubar.panel (light) with 3 mice. Optional menubar.panel.lowbattery (one mouse red at <=10%, Charging or approximate level) and menubar.label (status-item icon plus %, requested at 6x so it holds at 1:1). Fallback chain for 20.2-22.0: (1) menubar.label, (2) the Device pane activity-log line "Mac woke up; reapplying button configuration" if scripted in demo mode, supporting the wake claim, (3) a zoom on the low-battery or battery rows of the panel. Never draw a system menu bar and never fake a notification banner (system UI). Low-battery alerts (15% and 5%) are mentioned in the sub only.

scenes.caption: Nothing left behind. -- No kernel extension. No daemon. No account. / (23.6) Nothing is written to the mouse. Quit, and every button goes back.
scenes.onScreen: Lead "Nothing left " in primary and "behind." in accent. Sub 1 (22.6): "No kernel extension. No daemon. No account." Sub 2 (23.6): "Nothing is written to the mouse. Quit, and every button goes back." Real Settings > General (dark), Behavior section, with the app's own lines "Sleep and wake: Reapplied automatically" and "When Upright quits: Buttons return to their defaults".
scenes.motion: Theme returns to dark via a mirrored 0.4s wipe, right to left, 21.9-22.3. Panel exits (22.0, y -10, opacity) and the General window card enters 22.0-22.5 (y +40 to 0, scale .97 to 1). Lead 22.2, sub 1 at 22.6, sub 2 swaps in at 23.6 (0.2s crossfade, 8px slide). Camera pushes z 1.0 to ~1.4 onto Behavior 22.4-23.1. Ring on "Sleep and wake" 22.8-23.5 (also proof of the wake claim). Ring on "When Upright quits" plus the app's memory line, if present, 23.6-24.6. Caption exit 24.70-24.95. SFX: soft whoosh (lower) at 22.0, tick at 22.2.
scenes.visuals: Asset general.behavior (dark). Gate before render: grep GeneralPane.swift for the exact strings. If "nothing is written to the mouse's memory" is absent, or the audit finds that pointer speed (DPI) persists in the device, change sub 2 to the script's wording "Quit, and every button goes back to the mouse." Nothing here is drawn.

scenes.caption: Upright -- Free & open source · MIT -- github.com/dpdev69/upright
scenes.onScreen: Dark flat bg, centered stack. Optional real AppIcon (112px, from Upright/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset, never redrawn). Wordmark "Upright" 96px/600. "Free & open source · MIT" 36px dim. Primary line "github.com/dpdev69/upright" 64px/600 in accent, with a 3px accent underline. "Download the DMG from GitHub Releases" 30px dim. "or build it" 26px dim, then a mono code card (SF Mono 28px, ~1300px wide, faint fill, r14): git clone https://github.com/dpdev69/upright && cd upright && make app. "Requires macOS 13+" 28px dim, optionally joined with " · MX Vertical, MX Master, Lift and more". Footer 22px dim: "Not affiliated with Logitech. Logitech, MX and Logi Options+ are trademarks of their owners."
scenes.motion: Everything enters with outQuint, 0.45s, 12px rise, blur 6 to 0. 25.0 icon plus wordmark, 25.4 tagline, 26.0 URL (SFX: low settle), underline wipes in 26.3-26.7, 26.7 DMG line, 27.2 "or build it" plus code card (y +16 to 0), 27.9 requires line, 28.3 footer. All visible by ~28.75, then hold. Content fades out 29.7-30.0 (0.3s, content only, background stays flat dark; last frame t=29.967).
scenes.visuals: Type only, plus the optional real AppIcon. No Logitech logo, no product photo, no mouse. The mice list appears on the Requires line only if the README or the demo device list confirms it at render time. If not, drop it; the timing is unchanged.

endCard: Upright (wordmark, optional real AppIcon) / Free & open source · MIT / github.com/dpdev69/upright (accent, large) / Download the DMG from GitHub Releases / or build it: git clone https://github.com/dpdev69/upright && cd upright && make app (mono code card) / Requires macOS 13+ (optionally · MX Vertical, MX Master, Lift and more, gated on README or device-list confirmation) / footer: Not affiliated with Logitech. Logitech, MX and Logi Options+ are trademarks of their owners. Timing 25.0 / 25.4 / 26.0 / 26.7 / 27.2 / 27.9 / 28.3, hold, content-only 0.3s fade-out 29.7-30.0.
posterNotes:
POSTER: frameAt(5.4) rendered with poster:true. It keeps B1 (dark Settings > Buttons card, camera mid-push, ring on a row, "Open App" token active) but replaces the lead with the hook "Your Logitech mouse, / without Logi Options+." with "Logi Options+" in accent. This gives one still with real UI and the hook. A type-only frame at 2.4 would make a weak thumbnail. Export as a 1920x1080 PNG.

GLOBAL SPEC
- Canvas 1920x1080, 30fps, 900 frames, t=i/30, i=0..899. Pure frameAt(t). Pass 1 renders or resolves real UI states from the manifest. Pass 2 composites in HTML and ffmpeg encodes mp4 (H.264, yuv420p) plus the poster PNG.
- Tiling: hook 0-3, remap 3-7, profiles 7-10.6, gestures 10.6-14.2, feel 14.2-18, ready 18-22, clean 22-25, end 25-30. No gaps.
- Themes: dark 0-10.6, light 10.6-22.0, dark 22.0-30. Flip wipes at 10.5-10.9 (L to R) and 21.9-22.3 (R to L, mirrored). Plain flat or soft-radial bg only. Dark bg #0B0B0D (hook #000) with radial #17171C behind the card. Light bg #F5F5F7 with radial #FFFFFF. Text primary #F5F5F7 on dark and #1D1D1F on light, dim #86868B. Accent #0A84FF on dark and #0071E3 on light, via the .a class. Use .dim for secondary text.
- Type: SF Pro Display. Hook 104px/600. Caption lead 68px/600, tracking -0.02em, line-height 1.08. Sub 30px/400 dim. Left column x=120..860, vertically centered on y~540. Annotation chips use SF Mono 22px so nothing reads as app UI.
- Caption rule (every beat except hook and end): lead enters at start+0.2, sub at start+0.6 (0.45s outQuint, 12px rise, blur 6 to 0). Both exit together over 0.25s (inCubic) ending at end-0.05. Easings: outQuint for entrances, inCubic for exits, inOutCubic for camera (0.7-0.8s).
- Layout: Settings window PNG (1560x1120 at 2x) sits in a persistent 960px-wide rounded card (r14, soft shadow added by the compositor), center (1360,540), from 3.0 to 18.0. The portrait menu panel fits to height <=820 at center x=1360. Camera layer {u,v,z}. Cap z so displayed px per PNG px is <=1.1 (about z<=1.75 for the window, lower for the panel). Ask the exporter for 3x or 6x instead of upscaling. Assets that need to be big (menubar.label) are requested at 6x.
- Hard state swap: 0.12s linear crossfade, with a 1.015 to 1 settle on the changed region (0.2s outQuint). Highlight ring: 2px accent outline, r10, 12px glow, in 0.18 (outQuint), hold, out 0.25, tweens between targets over 0.2. Rings come from manifest rects. Rings, zooms, crops, pans and highlights are the only permitted edits to real PNGs.
- Audio (no voiceover): soft bed plus subtle ticks. Tick on each lead entrance (0.15, 0.90, 3.2, 7.2, 10.8, 14.4, 18.2, 22.2). Gentle whoosh at 10.6 (a lower one at 22.0). Low settle at 26.0 on the URL.

DEMO-MODE STATE IDS (dark and light each, 2x PNG plus manifest.json with row, slider and toggle rects)
Essential: buttons.global, buttons.profile (with "In effect now" and overridden rows), gesture.editor (5 rows filled), device.pointer (slider, presets, device list), scrolling (reverse and smooth on), menubar.panel (MX Vertical, MX Master 3S, Lift, battery rows), general.behavior.
Nice to have: buttons.global.1-6 label variants; buttons.profile.2; device.pointer.800/1600/3200; menubar.panel.lowbattery; menubar.label (6x); a scripted activity-log line for wake. Fallbacks are in each scene's visuals. Single state plus ring, zoom and pan always works.

STATUS FINDINGS (checked just now): Demo Mode has NOT landed. grep for export-snapshots and --demo over Upright/, UprightKit/ and the Makefile returns nothing, and there is no exported manifest. Only Upright/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset exists as a real asset. Do not run the built app with --demo yet: it would start a normal second instance that fights the user's running /Applications/Upright.app, which is diverting their real mouse. Never capture the real app (its Device pane shows a real serial number). Do not edit Swift sources or the Xcode project. Re-run the asset inventory against the real manifest when the demo flag lands. The proof-of-concept capture technique (same-process CGWindowListCreateImage on an opaque neutral backdrop) is in the assets notes.

CONFLICTS RESOLVED (brief wins)
1. Several mice: the flow notes said not to name multiple models and to use "Built for the MX Vertical" only. The brief explicitly wants several mice and names MX Master, Lift, etc. Resolution: keep the multi-mouse beat; names appear only as real UI text in the demo device list (MX Vertical, MX Master 3S, Lift). The end-card line "MX Vertical, MX Master, Lift and more" is included only if the README or device list confirms it at render time. M720 and Anywhere are never named on screen unless confirmed.
2. "Nothing written to the mouse": the script omitted it over a DPI-persistence doubt. The brief lists it. Resolution: included in sub 2 of B6, gated by the app's own General pane wording. Fallback string provided if the audit finds DPI persists.
3. "Reconnects instantly": the brief says instantly, the README says retried with backoff. Resolution: "Back the moment they wake", backed by the app's "Reapplied automatically" line (ringed in B6). Deliberate softening of "instantly".
4. Beats and themes: script's 8-scene, 30s timing (6 beats plus hook and end card) over the flow lane's 9 scenes. The flow lockup is folded into the hook sub and end card, and its Trust scene into B6. The script's dark/light flip at 10.6 and return at 22.0 is kept, and the brief asks for light and dark.
5. Profiles proof: Settings > Buttons profile state (script) instead of the flow's menu-bar header swaps. Panel variants are used only if exported as real states.
6. Remap: ring-stepping (script) plus label swaps (flow), the latter only with real variants.
7. Slider stepping: forbidden as synthesis (script), allowed as a sequence of real exported states (flow).
8. Motion and typography: script's caption timing offsets, flow's outQuint and blur easing. Lead 68px (flow) instead of 84px, because 84px does not fit the left column beside a 960px card.
9. End: script's 0.3s fade-out kept, but content-only (flow said no fade to black). End-card beat times tightened by 0.1-0.3s to give about 1s of full hold.

CLAIM GATES FOR THE FINAL OPUS AUDIT
- Check GeneralPane.swift for the exact strings quoted in B6. Check the README and CHANGELOG for no kext, no daemon, no account, MIT, macOS 13+. LICENSE is MIT.
- No telemetry claim is made beyond "No account". No Options+ comparison beyond the hook.
- No Logitech logos or product photography. The only mouse art is the abstract silhouette in B3.
- The disclaimer is on the end card. The Experimental label stays visible in the Scrolling shot.
- Fake-UI check: every UI pixel comes from exported PNGs. The only overlays are rings, tints, annotation chips, tokens and the silhouette.
